title: Payment Reconciliation & Chargeback Handling
learningObjectives: Reconcile internal transaction ledgers with external bank settlement files
Model partial refunds, dispute workflows, and penalty fee allocation
Generate automated variance reports and audit trails
keyTradeoffs: Automated automated settlement matching vs manual exceptions workflow
Immediate merchant account debit on dispute notice vs holding reserves
commonPitfalls: Refunding more than the original captured charge amount
Failing to account for currency exchange fluctuations between charge date and settlement date
transferPrompt: How do gateway chargeback webhooks trigger automatic license/subscription revocations in your app?
